treatment_method: Commercial knitted PET, 184 g/m2, supplied by Zhangjiagang Helian Textile. Materials describes acetone ultrasonic cleaning, repeated deionized-water washing, drying and storage in plastic sealing bags before treatments. The exact control-aliquot cleaning history and drying conditions are not separately specified. O-PET is the original reference before the separately described alkali deweighting, maleic-acid plasma grafting and PEPAS finishing.
washing_state: Initial original reference; no durability wash assigned; general preparatory cleaning described but control aliquot history not separately reported
limitations: Original published article text was retrieved from the public indexed document hosted on Scribd; the publisher independently confirms title, authors, DOI and publication date. No original PDF-byte hash or image-pixel verification is claimed. Only the internally consistent O-PET reference is extracted. LOI uncertainty0.16 is printed but its statistic and replicate count are unspecified. TG first and second peaks retain their source stage numbering; no DTA thermal peak is substituted. Mechanical-test ambient temperature and65% RH are not assumed to be LOI or TG conditioning. Control preparation beyond the general materials cleaning is not independently described. F-PET is held: Table 1 sample3 at150 W/20% MA/250 g/L has LOI29.1 plus/minus0.31, while Table2 and conclusion assign29.3 plus/minus0.29 to the stated optimum250 g/L; Table1 places29.3 at300 g/L. Thus the treated TG values cannot resolve which numerical LOI state is intended. All other loading/plasma states and20-laundry observations lack matched own TG. P-PET and alkali-only specimens are not assigned this control TG. Related same-group polyaniline PET DOI10.1177/0040517515606360 is known from the original reference list but its full control measurements were not retrieved; future control reuse needs original-source review, with no data borrowed or independence claimed from absent evidence.
